Ownable.transferOwnership, onlyOwner, reassigns owner

Investors.getInvestorsFee, returns fee tier derived from block.timestamp
Referral.invest payable entrypoint, mints tokens and credits owner service balance
Referral.distribute private loop distributing fees up the referral chain
Referral.updateStatus private, promotes node status based on thresholds
Referral.distributeInvestorsFee onlyOwner, credits investor balances
Referral.withdraw onlyOwner, sends ETH to _addr
Referral.withdrawOwner onlyOwner, sends contract ETH to _addr
Referral.withdrawToken onlyOwner, burns tokens and sends ETH
Referral payable fallback, accepts ETH without logic
PChannel payable fallback, forwards ETH to refProgram.invest
PChannel.setRefProgram onlyOwner, sets Referral address
Referral.setStatus onlyOwner, writes status into Data
Referral.invite onlyOwner, sets parent and initial status in Data
